data.name: Index_faq1
data.value: Please describe in detail the type of video you need; if you have a project brief, please attach it.

data.name: Index_FAQ2
data.value: The cost of editing depends on the volume of material, the complexity of the work, and additional services (such as color grading or animation). We can offer fixed rates or a custom quote after discussing the project details.

data.name: Index_faq_about_how_long_video_editing
data.value: Timelines depend on the project's complexity and the studio's current workload. Typically, simple projects can be completed within 3–5 business days, while more complex ones may take 1–2 weeks. We always aim to agree on timelines with the client in advance.

data.name: Index_faq_about_how_will_finished_be_delivered
data.value: We can deliver the finished video via cloud services (such as Google Drive or Dropbox) or send it by email, depending on the file size.

data.name: Index_faq_about_make_changes
data.value: Yes, we offer the option to make revisions after the initial viewing. Typically, the service package includes a certain number of revisions, but we are always open to discussing additional changes and their cost.

data.name: Index_faq_about_provide_music
data.value: Yes, we can help select music and sound design for your video. We have access to licensed music libraries and can offer several options to choose from, depending on the mood of your project.
